cheng (eng-platform): quick sync — thinking about adding a "latency_margin_ms" to region routing for hosted API. idea: prefer local region up to Xms delta, otherwise route to cheaper/capacity region. thoughts?

dylan (eng-runtime): curious — is delta based on p95 or instantaneous RTT? p95 seems safer but slower to react.

cheng (eng-platform): p95 over a 1m sliding window + per-tenant bias (paid tiers get smaller margin). prevents flip-flopping. also keep a short-term instantaneous probe for hard outages.

nina (product): from product POV: customers sometimes want to pin region. we need console toggles + audit logs for manual overrides. also show routing reason in the request sample.

rafael (eng-sre): telemetry note: add event `routing.decision` with fields: tenant_id, chosen_region, candidate_regions, p95_ms, margin_ms, reason, trace_id. expose agg metric `routing.cross_region_rate` per-tenant.

opsbot: deploy scheduled: routing-proxy v2 -> canary 10% at 1711804500 :gear:

dylan (eng-runtime): internal API debate — do we expose `prefer_local_region` flag on CreateInferenceRequest? pros: explicit for customers. cons: conflicts with autoscaling and cost routing.

cheng (eng-platform): i lean server-side only. prefer_local should be a tenant policy in the console (with audit trail), not a request-level flag except as an SDK header for ephemeral testing. fewer surfaces to support.

nina (product): compromise: console toggle + SDK header override for temporary debugging. no permanent API-level field unless it's part of tenant policy.

rafael (eng-sre): fallback for model variants: if primary variant overloaded, prefer deterministic fallback within same region (eg: quantized variant) BEFORE cross-region routing. we need metrics for semantic drift vs latency tradeoff.

dylan (eng-runtime): propose sequential fallback ordering: (1) same-region same-variant (retry), (2) same-region cheaper/quantized variant, (3) cross-region same-variant with `cross_region_penalty`. keep track of fallback_count in response headers.

cheng (eng-platform): agree. also add hysteresis: only allow cross-region after N consecutive backlog hits or > backlog_ms threshold. prevents noisy spikes causing global churn.

nina (product): UX request: show a short "routing path" trace for sampled requests in the console. not full payloads (privacy), just a decision tree: region -> variant -> reason -> latency_ms. useful for customer support.

rafael (eng-sre): quota interaction: if tenant has reserved/dedicated capacity, always prefer that region unless it's unhealthy. emit `routing.policy_violation` if we route outside reserved capacity. alert on >1% violation per hour.

opsbot: note: canary policy requires admitting only non-reserved tenants for first 10% rollout.

cheng (eng-platform): scoring function sketch:
```
score = observed_p95_ms + cross_region_penalty_ms + variant_penalty_ms - tenant_priority_bonus_ms
```
Lower score wins. we'll tune penalties by experiments.

dylan (eng-runtime): implementable. also add `routing.trace_id` header so we can correlate proxy decision -> model logs -> console trace.

rafael (eng-sre): i'll own telemetry schema and dashboards. one ask: make routing.decision lightweight (no heavy arrays), but include candidate_regions as comma-separated string. we'll sample full candidate payloads at 0.1% for debugging.

nina (product): action items: (1) add `latency_margin_ms` + `tenant_priority` to tenant policy API (console-first), (2) add sequential fallback ordering in proxy, (3) add `routing.decision` telemetry and a console trace UI sample, (4) docs for SDK header override and privacy notes.

cheng (eng-platform): engineer tasks: implement scoring + hysteresis + fallbacks. include unit tests for ordering and a simulation harness.

rafael (eng-sre): i'll produce dashboard mocks: cross_region_rate, avg_latency_by_region, fallback_counts, reserved_violation_rate. need schema approval from privacy/legal.

nina (product): i'll coordinate approvals and UX mocks. can we gate canary to only run for non-reserved tenants initially?

opsbot: canary policy updated: routing-proxy v2 -> 10% non-reserved tenants at 1711804500. will pause on >5% error spike.

dylan (eng-runtime): small API follow-up: if console exposes tenant policy, we need a stable tenant policy version in the control-plane so rollbacks are reproducible. do we store policy history?

cheng (eng-platform): yes — policy revisions with immutable IDs + canary tags. console shows current + previous two revisions.

nina (product): final Q: how do we communicate cost to customers when we cross-region for capacity? show estimated token cost delta in console for each routing decision?

rafael (eng-sre): we can calculate estimated cost_ms + cross_region_cost_penalty and surface it in the trace. keep it opt-in.

cheng (eng-platform): thanks all — i'll draft the tenant policy schema and open a PR for proxy changes. ping me for config keys. :thumbsup:
